meta.title: Idea Garden
meta.banner: Public nursery — private depth stays private.
meta.lead: Processed thinking others can walk. Seed → Sapling → Fruit. Not the Chronicle.
meta.membrane: Public-safe only. Held back: personal health notes, Monitor weights, Gmail archaeology depth, private hub paths, employer facts, novel catalog.
meta.hold: PUBLIC HOLD lifted for this splash only.

ideas.title: Project Naming Frame
ideas.blurb: Locked public names so doors stay distinct and talkable.

flow.stimulus: Projects blurred into each other when named casually.
flow.explored: A short frame that locks public-facing names.
flow.why: Clear names let strangers (and LLMs) load the right door.
flow.moved: Settled naming for Seer, SEER Consulting, Install, GROUNDED, Adventure Within.
flow.open: New doors still earn a name before they earn a URL.

ideas.title: Universal Markdown Doctrine
ideas.blurb: Markdown as shared language; load the smallest true file.

flow.stimulus: Long chats and scattered notes made context unreliable.
flow.explored: Treat Markdown as the portable canon across tools.
flow.why: Smallest true file beats a hall of mirrors.
flow.moved: Doctrine: load the smallest true MD; label facts vs interpretation.
flow.open: Which public MD fronts stay talkable without private twins.

ideas.title: SEER Consulting
ideas.blurb: Local counsel that stays human. Analytics inside the work.

flow.stimulus: Need a public firm face without turning AI into the product.
flow.explored: Human-first consulting with tools nested inside engagements.
flow.why: Trust stays local; tech serves the conversation.
flow.moved: Public consulting door live on the hub.
flow.open: How far the public face expands without overselling.

ideas.title: SEER Install
ideas.blurb: Company-scale context install: install, train, leave.

flow.stimulus: Teams want durable context, not another forever chat.
flow.explored: Install a shared Markdown/context layer, train, then leave.
flow.why: Ownership stays with the client after handoff.
flow.moved: Named as Install — distinct from personal Seer.
flow.open: Packaging and examples that stay public-safe.

ideas.title: GROUNDED
ideas.blurb: Weekly attention practice: lockbox, Scripture, silence, commit.

flow.stimulus: Attention frays under constant device pull.
flow.explored: A weekly form with phones locked away.
flow.why: Body and place first — formation before feed.
flow.moved: Public GROUNDED door with the practice shape.
flow.open: Local rhythm and who shows up in Kennesaw.

ideas.title: Anti-Attachment
ideas.blurb: A bouncer at the door. Open guardrails so AI stays a tool.

flow.stimulus: AI can feel like a friend or oracle too fast.
flow.explored: Open guardrails — a bouncer, not a ban.
flow.why: Keep the tool; refuse the attachment.
flow.open: How the rails stay sharp as tools change.

ideas.title: Fretboard Fire Drill
ideas.blurb: Shipped guitar fretboard drill — note to live tool with AI.

flow.stimulus: Wanted fretboard fluency without another dense theory book.
flow.explored: A focused drill app built with AI assistance.
flow.why: Proof that a seed can graduate to a live public tool.
flow.moved: Live at fretboard-fire-drill on GitHub Pages.
flow.open: What other small tools earn the same path.

ideas.title: Adventure Within
ideas.blurb: Improvisational indie rock. Loose structures that wander and return.

flow.stimulus: Music that wants room to improvise, not a rigid setlist brand.
flow.explored: Indie rock with motifs that wander and return.
flow.why: Creative work needs its own door, not forced under Seer.
flow.moved: Public Adventure Within page while recording continues.
flow.open: Releases and how the public page grows with them.

ideas.title: Seer
ideas.blurb: Personal OS — questions as the asset; local-first. Depth private.

flow.stimulus: Need a personal operating layer that is not a vendor chat.
flow.explored: Questions as the asset; constitution rails; local-first.
flow.why: Public can know the shape; private depth stays private.
flow.moved: Named and separated from Consulting and Install.
flow.open: What thin public surface (if any) ever graduates.

ideas.title: Digital Pensieve
ideas.blurb: Three layers named only: raw archive, factual timeline, interpretation.

flow.stimulus: Memory tools blend raw, fact, and story too easily.
flow.explored: Keep three layers distinct on purpose.
flow.why: Interpretation must not rewrite the archive silently.
flow.moved: Public naming of the three layers — no private dump.

ideas.title: Thinking flowcharts for others
ideas.blurb: Meta: this orchard — show processed thinking as a walkable flow.

flow.stimulus: Finished answers hide how a thought actually moved.
flow.explored: Stimulus → Explored → Why → Moved → Still open.
flow.why: Others (and future self) can walk the path, not just the conclusion.
flow.moved: This Idea Garden splash is the first public sketch.
flow.open: How much flow depth stays public vs private twin.

ideas.title: Layered Lenses dashboard
ideas.blurb: Idea only: filter and stack worldview lenses — criteria stay private.

flow.stimulus: One lens at a time flattens complex questions.
flow.explored: Stack lenses (people, faith, place, topics) as a dashboard idea.
flow.why: Seeing through something should help you see something through it.
flow.moved: Seed planted — no private criteria published here.
flow.open: Whether a thin public demo ever earns a page.

ideas.title: Open-source / open-LLM orientation
ideas.blurb: Model-agnostic Markdown canon; open-weight peers, not one vendor chat.

flow.stimulus: Locking to one chat vendor narrows the work.
flow.why: Portability and peer models keep the canon yours.
flow.moved: Named as a seed for how Seer and Install stay open.
flow.open: Practical defaults without a product pitch.

ideas.title: AI ≠ mechanic
ideas.blurb: Don’t use AI as the craft; use it to help understand the craft.

flow.stimulus: Temptation to let the model do the skilled work.
flow.explored: AI as tutor toward the mechanic, not the mechanic itself.
flow.why: Skill and judgment stay human; tools clarify.
flow.moved: Short critique seed for consulting and making.

ideas.title: AI as seizing oracle (critique)
ideas.blurb: Pattern-power that feels all-knowing can seize attention.

flow.stimulus: Oracle-feeling answers arrive with biometric and data creep.
flow.explored: Critique the seizing pattern, not just the usefulness.
flow.why: Name the pull so Anti-Attachment has teeth.
flow.moved: Seed critique kept public-safe and short.
flow.open: How to teach the critique without fear theater.

ideas.title: Guitar coach AI
ideas.blurb: Learn guitar with AI that analyzes playing — beside Fire Drill.

flow.stimulus: Practice feedback is sparse between lessons.
flow.explored: AI coach that listens and drills, not just chat tips.
flow.why: Music growth is embodied; feedback should meet the hands.
flow.moved: Seed next to shipped Fretboard Fire Drill.
flow.open: What ships next without bloating the drill.
